book.name: Amatiu
book.title: Ib̠eb̠i Asu̠gbagba Ma̠ Agu̠o̠ Amatiu Age̠ Bho̠

content: A̠ma̠zua̠n ta̠ Iloghodi̠ar bho̠

Igiel wa̠ u̠mar A̠zizo̠s, d̠a̠ Abe̠ti̠li̠he̠m wa̠ od̠i d̠a̠ A̠zudia̠ bho̠, bha̠ a̠sora̠n igiel wa̠ E̠ro̠d aro̠ ma̠ o̠li̠le̠ma bho̠, sa̠ iloghodi̠ar i̠d̠u̠a d̠a̠ agba opuomite ogogo bho̠ iru d̠a̠ A̠zeruse̠le̠m,
sa̠ ipura̠n ma̠a̠: “Od̠i d̠a̠ a̠ken O̠li̠le̠ma A̠zu wa̠ u̠mar bho̠? I̠yar u̠bi̠gh e̠ni̠nai̠ny D̠o̠yo̠ ma̠ igiel wa̠ a̠b̠etina̠ bho̠ sa̠ i̠yar uru ra̠ okpud̠ia̠n onigha̠ o̠yo̠.”
Igiel bho̠ E̠ro̠d amu̠gho̠n bho̠, sa̠ abar bho̠ a̠nyegi i̠na na̠ eb̠la̠ A̠zeruse̠le̠m.
Sa̠ a̠kokod̠i ma̠ eb̠la̠ ogbo aru̠mu̠ rokur bho̠ na̠ i̠tu̠ghu̠me̠ni̠ ma̠ oloko bho̠ sa̠ a̠pura̠n ma̠a̠, “Ta̠ o̠mar Akrai̠st bho̠ d̠a̠ a̠ken?”
Sa̠ awa i̠wo̠ran i̠na ma̠a̠: “D̠a̠ Abe̠ti̠li̠he̠m wa̠ od̠i d̠a̠ A̠zudia̠ bho̠, ezin bho̠ owil bho̠ age̠ ma̠ o̠ko̠no̠n a̠guri:

content.text: “ ‘Anwa Abe̠ti̠li̠he̠m wa̠ od̠i d̠a̠ ebhugh A̠zuda̠ bho̠, anwa i̠ki̠r a̠pu d̠a̠ ogbo irileghom ya̠ od̠i d̠a̠ A̠zuda̠ bho̠, ku̠ku̠m eka̠, o̠ni̠ irileghom ta̠ ad̠u̠a d̠a̠ oyom a̠mite, ma̠ ola̠ ta̠ a̠rileghom a̠nwunom D̠ami̠, Izre̠l.’

content: Sa̠ E̠ro̠d a̠bhelegi ma̠ iloghodi̠ar bho̠ d̠a̠ e̠wo̠gi̠na a̠pura̠n a̠loghom a̠ga̠i obhel wa̠ e̠ni̠nai̠ny bho̠ a̠mite bho̠.

Sa̠ a̠ruom awa ma̠a̠: “I̠gi̠e̠ d̠a̠ Abe̠ti̠li̠he̠m ka̠ e̠mar epura̠n egboloma̠ ma̠ O̠nyi̠ bho̠. Ka̠ inyin u̠bi̠gh, bha̠ id̠ighi ma̠ agu̠o̠ ola̠ ami̠ ta̠ a̠loghom epa̠, b̠o̠ka̠ ami̠ agi̠ ani̠ ka̠ a̠kpud̠ia̠n I̠na.”

Awa i̠mu̠gho̠n a̠fugh ta̠ O̠li̠le̠ma bho̠ i̠we̠le̠, sa̠ agu̠o̠ awa na̠ e̠d̠u̠a bho̠, sa̠ e̠ni̠nai̠ny wa̠ awa i̠bi̠gh d̠a̠ opuomite ogogo bho̠ a̠mite d̠a̠ ed̠ia̠ d̠a̠ awa sa̠ awa i̠tu̠o̠no̠m tu̠tu̠n ka̠ amara d̠a̠ anyu̠ esi wa̠ O̠nyi̠ bho̠ od̠i bho̠.
Sa̠ obhel bho̠ awa i̠bi̠gh e̠ni̠nai̠ny bho̠ sa̠ awa ibhon ologi ma̠ ibom.

Sa̠ awa id̠igh d̠a̠ otu bho̠ ka̠ i̠bi̠gh O̠nyi̠ bho̠ na̠ A̠meri onweni bho̠, sa̠ ikpud̠ia̠n I̠na, sa̠ ikpegion a̠rigba̠ i̠di̠ar edim d̠awa inigha̠ I̠na ma̠ e̠ne̠ghe̠: a̠gol na̠ afraki̠nse̠ns na̠ amaya.
Sa̠ awa i̠wo̠l opa̠n eten imula̠ iyel d̠a̠ ebhugh d̠awa, ezin bho̠ ukikiom awa d̠a̠ amala ma̠a̠ awa omula̠ d̠o̠ e̠gi̠ d̠a̠ E̠ro̠d.
Eghil wa̠ o̠d̠u̠a o̠gi̠ d̠a̠ Izipt

Agu̠o̠ awa i̠d̠u̠a bho̠, sa̠ otileduom ta̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ a̠mutuma̠ ma̠ A̠zose̠fu̠ d̠a̠ amala a̠fugh ma̠a̠: “B̠etina̠ ma̠ a̠bhin O̠nyi̠ bho̠ na̠ onweni D̠o̠yo̠ ma̠ anu̠r agi̠ d̠a̠ Izipt ka̠ aro̠, tu̠tu̠n anwa ta̠ a̠mula̠ amu̠gho̠n d̠a̠ o̠nu̠ d̠ami̠, ezin bho̠ E̠ro̠d ta̠ abho̠ro̠gh O̠nyi̠ bho̠ ma̠ ogigh.”
Sa̠ i̠na a̠b̠etina̠ epa̠, a̠bhin O̠nyi̠ bho̠ na̠ onweni D̠o̠yo̠ ma̠ a̠d̠ugula̠n obha̠ ad̠u̠a agi̠ d̠a̠ Izipt.
Sa̠ awa i̠ro̠ ma̠ i̠se̠ tu̠tu̠n E̠ro̠d a̠mugh, ma̠ agu̠o̠ ola̠ omuzoghod̠iom a̠fugh ta̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ bho̠ wa̠ awo̠l d̠a̠ owil a̠fugh ma̠a̠: “Ami̠ ibhelegi ma̠ O̠nyi̠ D̠ami̠ d̠a̠ Izipt a̠mutiom.”
O̠ze̠gi̠ I̠gbara Anwi̠i̠ny bho̠

Igiel bho̠ E̠ro̠d abi̠gh ma̠ iloghodi̠ar bho̠ na̠ egelemeni i̠na bho̠, sa̠ ologi do̠yo̠ a̠gurom, sa̠ ato̠ ma̠ a̠nwunom ma̠ o̠gi̠ ka̠ o̠ze̠gi̠ eb̠la̠ i̠gbara ilobhiri anwi̠i̠ny d̠a̠ Abe̠ti̠li̠he̠m na̠ eb̠la̠ eghighira̠ bho̠, ya̠ na̠ ed̠um i̠wal ala ma̠ obhin osor, ma̠ agu̠o̠ ola̠ ta̠ a̠sora̠n a̠ga̠i obhel wa̠ iloghodi̠ar bho̠ i̠gba inigha̠ i̠na bho̠.
Onon agu̠o̠ ubhin umuzoghod̠iom iwowa̠ ya̠ owil A̠zerimaya a̠wa̠ bho̠, ma̠a̠:

content.text: “U̠mu̠gho̠n o̠gba igbir d̠a̠ Arama, ed̠i na̠ i̠kparakpar ifinigha̠,
A̠rese̠l na̠ a̠leghe ma̠ anwi̠i̠ny d̠o̠yo̠, ma̠ ola̠ na̠ o̠le̠gh i̠na tu̠tu̠n ya̠a̠ i̠na na̠ onima̠ d̠o̠, ezin bho̠ awa na̠ emugughu.”

content: O̠d̠u̠a d̠a̠ Izipt O̠gi̠ d̠a̠ Anazare̠t
Igiel bho̠ E̠ro̠d a̠mugh bho̠, sa̠ otileduom ta̠ Wa̠nwuna̠ a̠mutuma̠ ma̠ A̠zose̠fu̠ d̠a̠ amala d̠a̠ Izipt
a̠fugh ma̠a̠: “B̠etina̠ ma̠ a̠bhin O̠nyi̠ bho̠ na̠ onweni D̠o̠yo̠ ma̠ agi̠ d̠a̠ ebhugh Izre̠l, ezin bho̠ ogbo ya̠ na̠ eku ma̠ a̠ghud̠um O̠nyi̠ bho̠ na̠ emugh.”
O̠ku̠a sa̠ i̠na a̠b̠etina̠ a̠bhin O̠nyi̠ bho̠ na̠ onweni bho̠ agi̠ d̠a̠ ebhugh Izre̠l.
Ya̠a̠ agu̠o̠ i̠na amu̠gho̠n ma̠a̠ Ake̠lo̠s o̠nyi̠ ta̠ E̠ro̠d na̠ a̠rileghom A̠zudia̠ bho̠, sa̠ i̠na a̠ghil o̠gi̠ i̠se̠, sa̠ ukikiom i̠na d̠a̠ amala ma̠ o̠gi̠ d̠a̠ agba Agalili.
Sa̠ i̠na agi̠ ka̠ a̠rugh d̠a̠ e̠ma ola̠ ubhelegi ma̠ Anazare̠t, ma̠ omuzoghod̠iom i̠di̠ar ya̠ u̠wo̠l d̠a̠ owil bho̠ u̠gba ma̠a̠: “Ta̠ obhelegi I̠na ma̠a̠ ola̠ Anazare̠t.”
